Rules relevant to this task:

diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 7505656..574f35b 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,26 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+The project has no test suite yet — `pytest` currently collects 0 items. The commands below describe the intended workflow, so they will start reporting real results as soon as test files are added.
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/), which is not declared as a project dependency; install it into your environment first:
+
+```
+python3 -m pip install pytest
+```
+
+Run the whole suite from the repository root:
+
+```
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file, or a single test within it:
+
+```
+python3 -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+python3 -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+New tests go in files named `test_*.py` at the repository root, next to the module they cover — pytest discovers them automatically, so no configuration file is required.
